text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear topic sentence and repeated claim of continuation","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a definite position early and keeps that position explicit throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"three separate body paragraphs on fuel, flexibility, and safety","quality":"organization","description":"It groups reasons into distinct paragraphs, making the argument easier to follow and develop."},{"evidence":"explanations after each quote","quality":"development","description":"It does more than cite evidence by explaining how the details support the claim."},{"evidence":"counterargument about boredom and distraction","quality":"argumentative balance","description":"It acknowledges an opposing concern and answers it instead of only listing praise."},{"evidence":"formal concluding paragraph restating reasons","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by summarizing the argument and reinforcing the position in a complete closing."}]}
